description: The usage gap is CPU minus GPU, keeping the sign.

b.request: Group scanprocessing records whose zoneref matches a site in sites by site code and insurstat, and for each group show the average remaining storage (remaingb) and the average of (proccpu − procgpu), a signed CPU-minus-GPU gap where negatives are kept. Ignore NULLs in the averages, and compute the ratio of each group's average remaining storage to the mean of all groups' non-NULL average remaining storage (no rows if that mean is NULL), without rounding. Sort by the ratio descending with NULL ratios last and return the top 10 rows
b.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry AS zone_code, s.insurstat AS insurstat, AVG(p.remaingb) AS avg_remain, AVG(p.proccpu - p.procgpu) AS avg_gap FROM scanprocessing p JOIN sites s ON p.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_remain) AS mean_remain FROM g) SELECT g.zone_code, g.insurstat, g.avg_remain, g.avg_gap, g.avg_remain / m.mean_remain AS ratio FROM g CROSS JOIN m WHERE m.mean_remain IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ratio IS NULL, ratio DESC LIMIT 10

a.request: Using only processing records whose site code (`scanprocessing.zoneref`) matches a site in `sites`, group by that site code and the site's insurance status (`sites.insurstat`). For each group, show the site code, the insurance status, the average remaining storage (`remaingb`), the average of CPU usage minus GPU usage (`proccpu` − `procgpu`, kept signed so it can be negative), and the ratio of the group's average remaining storage to the mean of all groups' average remaining storage values (ignoring missing ones; return no rows if that mean is missing). Ignore missing values in all averages and don't round anything. Sort by that ratio from highest to lowest with missing ratios last, and return only the top 10 rows.
a.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT sp.zoneref AS zoneref, s.insurstat AS insurstat, AVG(sp.remaingb) AS avg_remaining, AVG(sp.proccpu - sp.procgpu) AS avg_cpu_minus_gpu FROM scanprocessing sp JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = sp.zoneref GROUP BY sp.zoneref, s.insurstat), m AS (SELECT g.*, AVG(avg_remaining) OVER () AS mean_avg FROM g) SELECT zoneref, insurstat, avg_remaining, avg_cpu_minus_gpu, avg_remaining / mean_avg AS ratio FROM m WHERE mean_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

c.request: Using only processing records whose site code (`scanprocessing.zoneref`) matches a site in `sites`, group by that site code and the site's insurance status (`sites.insurstat`). For each group, show the site code, the insurance status, the average remaining storage (`remaingb`), the average CPU–GPU usage gap (`proccpu`, `procgpu`), and the ratio of the group's average remaining storage to the mean of all groups' average remaining storage values (ignoring missing ones; return no rows if that mean is missing). Ignore missing values in all averages and don't round anything. Sort by that ratio from highest to lowest with missing ratios last, and return only the top 10 rows. The usage gap is CPU minus GPU, keeping the sign.
c.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT sp.zoneref AS zoneref, s.insurstat AS insurstat, AVG(sp.remaingb) AS avg_remaining_gb, AVG(sp.proccpu - sp.procgpu) AS avg_cpu_gpu_gap FROM scanprocessing sp JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = sp.zoneref GROUP BY sp.zoneref, s.insurstat), m AS (SELECT g.*, AVG(avg_remaining_gb) OVER () AS mean_avg FROM g) SELECT zoneref, insurstat, avg_remaining_gb, avg_cpu_gpu_gap, avg_remaining_gb / mean_avg AS remaining_ratio FROM m WHERE mean_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY remaining_ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

d.request: Using only processing records whose site code (`scanprocessing.zoneref`) matches a site in `sites`, group by that site code and the site's insurance status (`sites.insurstat`). For each group, show the site code, the insurance status, the average remaining storage (`remaingb`), and the average CPU–GPU usage gap, defined as `proccpu` minus `procgpu` with the sign kept (so negative values stay negative), along with the ratio of the group's average remaining storage to the mean of all groups' average remaining storage values (ignoring missing ones; return no rows if that mean is missing). Ignore missing values in all averages and don't round anything. Sort by that ratio from highest to lowest with missing ratios last, and return only the top 10 rows.
d.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT p.zoneref AS zoneref, s.insurstat AS insurstat, AVG(p.remaingb) AS avg_remain, AVG(p.proccpu - p.procgpu) AS avg_gap FROM scanprocessing p JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = p.zoneref GROUP BY p.zoneref, s.insurstat), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_remain) AS mean_remain FROM g) SELECT g.zoneref AS site_code, g.insurstat AS insurance_status, g.avg_remain AS avg_remaining_storage, g.avg_gap AS avg_cpu_gpu_gap, g.avg_remain / m.mean_remain AS ratio FROM g CROSS JOIN m WHERE m.mean_remain IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
